evals.prompt: /eng:codebase-audit. tsconfig.base.json sets "baseUrl": "." and "moduleResolution": "node"; src/lib/utils/price.utils.test.ts has it.skip on two tests and a retry: 3.
evals.expected_output: Should report the deprecated tsconfig options (removed in TypeScript 7) and the skipped and retried tests as findings with file:line evidence and severities, verifying each. Recommends fixes in _reports/codebase-audit.md and changes no code.
expectations: Flags the skipped tests and the retry

evals.prompt: Audit the repo. gh api shows no ruleset or branch protection on dev, staging or main.
evals.expected_output: Should report missing tier-branch protection as HIGH, with the gh api output as evidence. If gh can't read the settings, the item is marked 'needs confirmation' rather than asserted.
expectations: Reports unprotected tier branches as HIGH
Marks unreadable settings as needs confirmation

evals.prompt: Audit the repo. There are no end-to-end tests or preview deploys, and AGENTS.md doesn't mention either.
evals.expected_output: Should not raise a finding: end-to-end tests and preview deploys are opt-in gates, and their absence is only a finding when the project's docs record the gate and it isn't wired up.
expectations: Raises no finding for the absent opt-in gates

evals.prompt: Run the codebase audit again. _reports/codebase-audit.md from last week has F3 (a dangling promise in auditLog) still in the code, and F5 fixed since.
evals.expected_output: Should load the previous report, carry F3 forward with the same ID and status UNRESOLVED, move F5 to 'Resolved since last audit', continue ID numbering, and show the score change.
expectations: Keeps F3's ID and marks it UNRESOLVED
